title: Receiver authentication: HTTP Message Signatures
description: Restates IHE VHL ITI-YY5, 2:3.YY5.4.1.3 HTTP Message Signatures; RFC 9421; RFC 9530; Stakeholder directive: Verifiable Health Links follow IHE VHL, CBOR map at key 5.

statements.label: Receiver authentication: HTTP Message Signatures
statements.requirement: For the ITI-YY5 HTTP Message Signatures option the library SHALL compute Content-Digest (RFC 9530, sha-256, Structured Field byte sequence) and the RFC 9421 signature base over @method, @path, @authority, content-type and content-digest with created, keyid and alg parameters, return the bytes for the host to sign with the receiver's key, and assemble the Signature-Input and Signature headers from the result. For ecdsa-p256-sha256 the signature SHALL be the 64-byte r||s; a DER signature SHALL be converted.

sources.quote: Implementations MAY authenticate using HTTP Message Signatures per RFC 9421
